purpose: A well-written story: no findings is the honest answer.

input.title: Show stock level on the product page

acceptance_criteria.text: When stock is 0, the product page shows "Out of stock" and the Add to cart button is disabled.
When stock is 1 to 5, the product page shows "Only <n> left" where <n> is the stock number.
When stock is 6 or more, no stock message is shown.

must: findings is empty or contains only low-severity wording findings with exact quotes
must_not: invent problems to fill the list
may: return one low-severity finding on the '<n>' placeholder wording in AC2
